_note: Starting points, not truths. A provider's free-tier limits are per PROJECT and
per KEY: the same model can be 15 requests a minute for one user and something
else for the next, and Google no longer publishes the per-model numbers outside
a logged-in console. So these are what to assume until the app has watched its
own calls (app/services/rate_limits.py), and the measured value always wins.
Patterns are matched most-specific-first with fnmatch.
rpm = requests per minute, rpd = requests per day, tpm = input tokens per minute.

*flash-lite*.source: AI Studio rate-limit console, free tier, 2026-08-15

gemma*.note: Plenty of requests, tiny token budget: a 4k-token scoring prompt fits about twice a minute.

*flash*.note: Twenty requests a DAY. Enough to try the model, never enough to scan with it.

*:free.note: 1000/day per model applies once the account has bought credit at least once; 50/day before that. The per-minute ceiling is the host's shared pool and is not published — 20 is a conservative guess, and the measured value replaces it.

*.note: Free tier closes 2026-08-17. Its throttle is per-minute and tight: 94 calls in five minutes saturated it.
